title: Investigate/resize macintel01 control-plane saturation — standing NodeCPUCritical/KubeAPIServerSlow since Aug (UTM VM on 2020 i7 Mac, apiserver ~3 cores idle, system/softirq-bound)
notes:
Evidence 2026-10-15: macintel01 UTM VM (8 vCPU) pinned at 100-104% CPU with zero client traffic (30s apiserver_request delta empty), fresh apiserver restart rebaselines at ~18k goroutines, guest CPU steal=0 (not host contention), load avg 41, burn is system+softirq bound. Aug 2026 postmortem called this 'separate cause', never root-caused. Fix direction: bigger control-plane VM or move off the shared 2020 Mac host.
ArgoCD sync blocker 2026-10-15: during macintel01 burn, the apiserver openapi/v2 body read degrades catastrophically — from tp4 (LAN): 200 OK 12MB in 66.3s; from workstation same hour: 22MB in 0.09s. Every ArgoCD apply validates against this schema, so all syncs fail with 'error validating data: failed to download openapi: net/http: request cancel' / 'context deadline exceeded while reading body'. Confirmed live: vmks op 82 resources SyncFailed with that error (17:2x), then Succeeded on retry #4 (17:4x) when a slow-fetch window got through. support-cluster op same signature. This is the mechanism making ArgoCD wedges during burn windows; bigger control-plane VM (or off-host control plane) fixes both the burn and the sync stalls.
